verses.mystical_translation: Authority becomes most dangerous when titles are allowed to blur accountability.
The poem enters through royal oracle, yhwh/adoni distinction, enemies, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when memory, power, vulnerability, and desire are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
